provenance.checkpointAnchor: Original training_metrics.json checkpoint and configuration hashes verified against the saved run.
provenance.frameIndexConvention: Prediction startFrame and endFrame are zero-based inclusive; JPEG filenames are one-based. Each window uses exactly five consecutive source files.
provenance.sourceDescription: Existing raw broadcast frame sequences; visible scoreboard reads HERBERT / TOPURIA. Original source video and acquisition timestamps were not recorded.
provenance.interpretation: Recorded offline scores from the development checkpoint on these exact raw frames. Model labels are threshold-derived predictions, not reviewed annotations. Scores are not calibrated confidence or measured accuracy. Edited sequences may contain cuts and replays; playback rate is not source timing.
